name: Chili Powder
siboNotes: Pure chili powder is well-tolerated in typical cooking amounts. Check labels for garlic or onion powder additions which would make it high FODMAP.
preparationTips: Read ingredient labels carefully - many commercial chili powders contain garlic or onion powder
Look for single-ingredient chili powder or make your own blend
Start with small amounts and adjust to taste preference
Store in airtight container away from light to preserve flavor
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin A and carotenoids
